description: This Java source file defines the class 'DatabaseUpdaterLiquibaseProvider' which implements the 'LiquibaseProvider' interface. The class serves as a wrapper to provide Liquibase instances based on a changelog file, facilitating dependency injection for database update mechanisms within the OpenMRS project.

classes.name: DatabaseUpdaterLiquibaseProvider
classes.description: A class that implements LiquibaseProvider, providing a method to retrieve Liquibase instances for database updates.

methods.name: getLiquibase
methods.description: Returns a Liquibase object initialized with the specified changelog file, delegating to DatabaseUpdater.getLiquibase.
